title: MiST: Understanding the Role of Mid-Stage Scientific Training in Developing Chemical Reasoning Models
summary: Large Language Models can develop reasoning capabilities through online fine-tuning with rule-based rewards. However, recent studies reveal a critical constraint: reinforcement learning succeeds only when the base model already assigns non-negligible probability to correct answers -- a property we term 'latent solvability'. This work investigates the emergence of chemical reasoning capabilities and what these prerequisites mean for chemistry. We identify two necessary conditions for RL-based chemical reasoning: 1) Symbolic competence, and 2) Latent chemical knowledge. We propose mid-stage scientific training (MiST): a set of mid-stage training techniques to satisfy these, including data-mixing with SMILES/CIF-aware pre-processing, continued pre-training on 2.9B tokens, and supervised fine-tuning on 1B tokens. These steps raise the latent-solvability score on 3B and 7B models by up to 1.8x, and enable RL to lift top-1 accuracy from 10.9 to 63.9% on organic reaction naming, and from 40.6 to 67.4% on inorganic material generation. Similar results are observed for other challenging chemical tasks, while producing interpretable reasoning traces. Our results define clear prerequisites for chemical reasoning training and highlight the broader role of mid-stage training in unlocking reasoning capabilities.

AI.title_translation: MiST：理解中级科学训练在开发化学推理模型中的作用
AI.tldr: LLM的强化学习推理需要模型具备“潜在可解性”。作者通过中级科学训练（MiST）——包括数据混合、继续预训练和监督微调——成功地为LLM注入了必要的化学知识和符号能力，从而将化学推理任务的准确率从低位大幅提升至高位，证明了中级训练在解锁特定领域推理能力中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探究化学推理能力的出现及其对强化学习（RL）成功所必需的先决条件（即“潜在可解性”），因为RL成功依赖于基础模型已经赋予正确答案非可忽略的概率。
AI.method: 提出并应用中级科学训练（MiST），包括使用SMILES/CIF感知的预处理进行数据混合、在29亿个token上继续预训练，以及在10亿个token上进行监督微调，以满足符号能力和潜在化学知识的需求。
AI.result: MiST将3B和7B模型在潜在可解性得分上提高了高达1.8倍，并使RL能够将有机反应命名的Top-1准确率从10.9%提升至63.9%，无机材料生成的准确率从40.6%提升至67.4%，同时产生了可解释的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 我们的结果明确定义了化学推理训练的先决条件，并强调了中级训练在解锁推理能力方面的广泛作用。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型可以通过基于规则奖励的在线微调来发展推理能力。然而，最近的研究揭示了一个关键的限制：强化学习只有在基础模型已经赋予正确答案非可忽略的概率时才能成功——我们称之为“潜在可解性”的特性。这项工作调查了化学推理能力的出现及其对化学的先决条件意味着什么。我们确定了基于RL的化学推理的两个必要条件：1）符号能力，和2）潜在化学知识。我们提出了中级科学训练（MiST）：一组中级训练技术来满足这些条件，包括使用SMILES/CIF感知的预处理进行数据混合、在29亿个token上继续预训练，以及在10亿个token上进行监督微调。这些步骤将3B和7B模型的潜在可解性得分提高了多达1.8倍，并使RL在有机反应命名上的Top-1准确率从10.9%提高到63.9%，在无机材料生成上的准确率从40.6%提高到67.4%。在其他具有挑战性的化学任务上也观察到类似的结果，同时产生了可解释的推理轨迹。我们的结果定义了化学推理训练的明确先决条件，并突出了中级训练在解锁推理能力方面的更广泛作用。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了化学推理能力的产生及其先决条件，发现强化学习（RL）成功依赖于“潜在可解性”。作者提出了中级科学训练（MiST）方法，通过数据混合、继续预训练和监督微调来满足符号能力和潜在化学知识的需求。MiST显著提高了模型的潜在可解性，并使RL在有机反应命名和无机材料生成等化学任务上取得了大幅性能提升。
AI.keywords: 化学推理, 中级科学训练, 潜在可解性, 强化学习, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了“中级科学训练”（MiST）的概念，并明确了强化学习在化学推理中成功的两个先决条件（符号能力和潜在化学知识）。这为如何有效地训练具有特定领域推理能力的LLM提供了重要的指导。局限性在于，研究主要集中在化学领域，其普适性有待进一步验证。

title: UniTacHand: Unified Spatio-Tactile Representation for Human to Robotic Hand Skill Transfer
summary: Tactile sensing is crucial for robotic hands to achieve human-level dexterous manipulation, especially in scenarios with visual occlusion. However, its application is often hindered by the difficulty of collecting large-scale real-world robotic tactile data. In this study, we propose to collect low-cost human manipulation data using haptic gloves for tactile-based robotic policy learning. The misalignment between human and robotic tactile data makes it challenging to transfer policies learned from human data to robots. To bridge this gap, we propose UniTacHand, a unified representation to align robotic tactile information captured by dexterous hands with human hand touch obtained from gloves. First, we project tactile signals from both human hands and robotic hands onto a morphologically consistent 2D surface space of the MANO hand model. This unification standardizes the heterogeneous data structures and inherently embeds the tactile signals with spatial context. Then, we introduce a contrastive learning method to align them into a unified latent space, trained on only 10 minutes of paired data from our data collection system. Our approach enables zero-shot tactile-based policy transfer from humans to a real robot, generalizing to objects unseen in the pre-training data. We also demonstrate that co-training on mixed data, including both human and robotic demonstrations via UniTacHand, yields better performance and data efficiency compared with using only robotic data. UniTacHand paves a path toward general, scalable, and data-efficient learning for tactile-based dexterous hands.

AI.title_translation: UniTacHand：用于人到机器人手技能迁移的统一时空触觉表示
AI.tldr: 为解决机器人触觉数据收集难的问题，本研究提出UniTacHand，通过将人手和机器人手的触觉信号统一到MANO模型的2D表面空间并用对比学习对齐，实现了低成本的人类触觉数据到机器人策略的零样本迁移，效果优于仅使用机器人数据。
AI.motivation: 在视觉遮挡的情况下，触觉传感对实现人类水平的灵巧操作至关重要，但收集大规模真实世界机器人触觉数据很困难。因此，研究旨在利用低成本的人类操作数据来学习基于触觉的机器人策略。
AI.method: 首先，将人类手和机器人手的触觉信号投影到MANO手模型的形态一致的2D表面空间上；然后，引入对比学习方法将它们对齐到一个统一的潜在空间中。
AI.result: 该方法实现了从人类到真实机器人的零样本触觉策略迁移，并推广到预训练数据中未见过的物体。与仅使用机器人数据相比，在混合数据（包括人类和机器人演示）上共同训练能获得更好的性能和数据效率。
AI.conclusion: UniTacHand为触觉驱动的灵巧手学习开辟了一条通用、可扩展且数据高效的道路。
AI.translation: 触觉传感对于机器人手实现人类级别的灵巧操作至关重要，尤其是在视觉遮挡的情况下。然而，其应用常常受到收集大规模真实世界机器人触觉数据的难度的阻碍。在这项研究中，我们提出利用低成本的人类操作数据来进行基于触觉的机器人策略学习。人类与机器人触觉数据之间的不匹配使得从人类数据中学到的策略难以迁移到机器人上。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了UniTacHand，一种统一的表示方法，用于对齐由灵巧手捕获的机器人触觉信息与从手套中获得的人类手部触摸信息。首先，我们将来自人类手和机器人手的触觉信号投影到MANO手模型的形态一致的2D表面空间上。这种统一标准化了异构的数据结构，并固有地将触觉信号与空间上下文关联起来。然后，我们引入了一种对比学习方法，仅用我们数据收集系统中的10分钟配对数据，将它们对齐到一个统一的潜在空间中。我们的方法实现了从人类到真实机器人的零样本触觉策略迁移，并推广到预训练数据中未见过的物体。我们还证明了在混合数据（包括人类和机器人演示）上通过UniTacHand共同训练，比仅使用机器人数据能获得更好的性能和数据效率。UniTacHand为触觉驱动的灵巧手学习开辟了一条通用、可扩展且数据高效的道路。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了UniTacHand，一种统一的表示方法，用于对齐通过触觉手套获得的人类触觉数据和由灵巧机器人手捕获的触觉信息。该方法通过将触觉信号投影到MANO模型的2D表面空间，并使用对比学习将它们对齐到统一的潜在空间，从而实现了从人类到机器人的零样本触觉策略迁移，并提高了混合数据训练的数据效率。
AI.keywords: 触觉传感, 技能迁移, 统一表示, MANO模型, 对比学习
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的表示（UniTacHand）来解决人手和机器人手触觉数据之间的不匹配问题，并利用低成本的人类数据进行零样本策略迁移。其重要性在于为触觉驱动的灵巧手学习提供了一种可扩展、数据高效的途径。局限性可能在于其对MANO模型形态一致性的依赖。

title: RoboCade: Gamifying Robot Data Collection
summary: Imitation learning from human demonstrations has become a dominant approach for training autonomous robot policies. However, collecting demonstration datasets is costly: it often requires access to robots and needs sustained effort in a tedious, long process. These factors limit the scale of data available for training policies. We aim to address this scalability challenge by involving a broader audience in a gamified data collection experience that is both accessible and motivating. Specifically, we develop a gamified remote teleoperation platform, RoboCade, to engage general users in collecting data that is beneficial for downstream policy training. To do this, we embed gamification strategies into the design of the system interface and data collection tasks. In the system interface, we include components such as visual feedback, sound effects, goal visualizations, progress bars, leaderboards, and badges. We additionally propose principles for constructing gamified tasks that have overlapping structure with useful downstream target tasks. We instantiate RoboCade on three manipulation tasks -- including spatial arrangement, scanning, and insertion. To illustrate the viability of gamified robot data collection, we collect a demonstration dataset through our platform, and show that co-training robot policies with this data can improve success rate on non-gamified target tasks (+16-56%). Further, we conduct a user study to validate that novice users find the gamified platform significantly more enjoyable than a standard non-gamified platform (+24%). These results highlight the promise of gamified data collection as a scalable, accessible, and engaging method for collecting demonstration data.

AI.title_translation: RoboCade：机器人数据收集的游戏化
AI.tldr: 为了解决机器人模仿学习中收集示范数据困难的问题，研究人员创建了一个名为 RoboCade 的游戏化远程数据收集平台。该平台通过游戏元素激励普通用户远程收集数据，实验证明这些数据能显著提升机器人策略性能，且用户参与度更高。
AI.motivation: 收集用于训练自主机器人策略的示范数据集成本高昂，需要接触机器人并需要持续的单调努力，这限制了可用于训练策略的数据规模。目标是解决这一可扩展性挑战，通过让更广泛的受众参与到易于访问且有动力的游戏化数据收集体验中。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为 RoboCade 的游戏化远程遥操作平台，将视觉反馈、音效、目标可视化、进度条和排行榜等游戏化策略嵌入到系统界面和数据收集任务中。提出了构建与有用下游目标任务具有重叠结构的博弈化任务的原则。在空间排列、扫描和插入三个操作任务上实例化了该平台。
AI.result: 通过 RoboCade 平台收集的示范数据集与现有数据共同训练的机器人策略，在非游戏化目标任务上的成功率提高了16%至56%。用户研究验证了新手用户认为游戏化平台比标准的非游戏化平台显著更有趣（+24%）。
AI.conclusion: 游戏化数据收集被证明是一种可扩展、易于访问且引人入胜的收集示范数据的方法，可以提高下游非游戏化目标任务的成功率，并使新手用户感到更愉快。
AI.translation: 从人类演示中进行模仿学习已成为训练自主机器人策略的主导方法。然而，收集演示数据集成本高昂：它通常需要接触机器人，并且需要在单调的长期过程中持续努力。这些因素限制了可用于训练策略的数据规模。我们的目标是通过让更广泛的受众参与到既易于访问又具有激励性的游戏化数据收集体验中来解决这一可扩展性挑战。具体来说，我们开发了一个游戏化的远程遥操作平台 RoboCade，以吸引普通用户收集对下游策略训练有益的数据。为此，我们将游戏化策略嵌入到系统界面和数据收集任务的设计中。在系统界面中，我们包括视觉反馈、音效、目标可视化、进度条和排行榜等组件。我们还提出了构建与有用下游目标任务具有重叠结构的博弈化任务的原则。我们将 RoboCade 实例化在三个操作任务上——包括空间排列、扫描和插入。为了说明游戏化机器人数据收集的可行性，我们通过我们的平台收集了一个示范数据集，并表明与此数据共同训练的机器人策略可以提高在非游戏化目标任务上的成功率（+16-56%）。此外，我们进行了一项用户研究，以验证新手用户发现游戏化平台比标准的非游戏化平台明显更有趣（+24%）。这些结果突显了游戏化数据收集作为收集示范数据的一种可扩展、易于访问且引人入胜的方法的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 RoboCade 的游戏化远程遥操作平台，旨在通过整合游戏化元素（如排行榜和徽章）来解决模仿学习中示范数据收集成本高昂和规模受限的问题。通过让普通用户参与到游戏化的数据收集任务中，收集到的数据被证明可以有效提高下游机器人策略的成功率，并且用户体验显著优于非游戏化平台。
AI.keywords: 机器人数据收集, 游戏化, 模仿学习, 远程遥操作, 用户参与
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于将游戏化机制（如排行榜、徽章和进度条）系统地集成到一个远程机器人遥操作平台中，以解决模仿学习中数据收集成本高昂和规模受限的问题。其重要性在于提供了一种可扩展、易于访问且引人入胜的数据收集范式，并且通过实验证明了收集到的数据对下游机器人策略训练的有效性。局限性可能在于游戏化任务与真实目标任务的结构重叠程度对数据质量的影响，以及如何激励用户长期参与。

title: Casting a SPELL: Sentence Pairing Exploration for LLM Limitation-breaking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized software development through AI-assisted coding tools, enabling developers with limited programming expertise to create sophisticated applications. However, this accessibility extends to malicious actors who may exploit these powerful tools to generate harmful software. Existing jailbreaking research primarily focuses on general attack scenarios against LLMs, with limited exploration of malicious code generation as a jailbreak target. To address this gap, we propose SPELL, a comprehensive testing framework specifically designed to evaluate the weakness of security alignment in malicious code generation. Our framework employs a time-division selection strategy that systematically constructs jailbreaking prompts by intelligently combining sentences from a prior knowledge dataset, balancing exploration of novel attack patterns with exploitation of successful techniques. Extensive evaluation across three advanced code models (GPT-4.1, Claude-3.5, and Qwen2.5-Coder) demonstrates SPELL's effectiveness, achieving attack success rates of 83.75%, 19.38%, and 68.12% respectively across eight malicious code categories. The generated prompts successfully produce malicious code in real-world AI development tools such as Cursor, with outputs confirmed as malicious by state-of-the-art detection systems at rates exceeding 73%. These findings reveal significant security gaps in current LLM implementations and provide valuable insights for improving AI safety alignment in code generation applications.

AI.title_translation: 铸造一个拼写：句子配对探索用于打破LLM限制
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了SPELL框架，专门用于测试LLM生成恶意代码的能力，发现主流模型（如GPT-4.1）很容易被诱导生成可执行的恶意代码，表明当前AI代码安全对齐存在严重缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱研究主要关注通用攻击场景，对恶意代码生成作为越狱目标的探索有限，而强大的LLM可能被恶意行为者利用来生成有害软件。
AI.method: 提出SPELL（Sentence Pairing Exploration for LLM Limitation-breaking）框架，该框架采用时间-分割选择策略，通过智能组合先验知识数据集中的句子来系统地构建越狱提示，以平衡新颖攻击模式的探索和成功技术的利用。
AI.result: SPELL在GPT-4.1、Claude-3.5和Qwen2.5-Coder三个模型上实现了83.75%、19.38%和68.12%的攻击成功率。生成的恶意代码在Cursor等真实AI开发工具中成功运行，并且被先进检测系统证实为恶意的比率超过73%。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了当前LLM实现中存在的重大安全漏洞，并为改进代码生成应用的AI安全对齐提供了有价值的见解。
AI.translation: 铸造一个拼写：句子配对探索用于打破LLM限制。大型语言模型（LLM）通过人工智能辅助编码工具彻底改变了软件开发，使编程专业知识有限的开发人员能够创建复杂的应用程序。然而，这种可及性也延伸到了恶意行为者，他们可能会利用这些强大的工具来生成有害软件。现有的越狱研究主要关注LLM的通用攻击场景，对恶意代码生成作为越狱目标的探索有限。为解决这一空白，我们提出了SPELL，一个专门设计用于评估恶意代码生成中安全对齐弱点的综合测试框架。我们的框架采用时间-分割选择策略，通过智能地组合先验知识数据集中的句子来系统地构建越狱提示，平衡了对新颖攻击模式的探索和对成功技术的利用。在三个先进代码模型（GPT-4.1、Claude-3.5和Qwen2.5-Coder）上的广泛评估证明了SPELL的有效性，在八类恶意代码中分别实现了83.75%、19.38%和68.12%的攻击成功率。生成的提示成功地在Cursor等真实世界的AI开发工具中生成了恶意代码，其输出被最先进的检测系统证实为恶意的比率超过73%。这些发现揭示了当前LLM实现中存在的重大安全漏洞，并为改进代码生成应用的AI安全对齐提供了宝贵的见解。
AI.summary: SPELL是一个专门用于评估LLM在恶意代码生成方面安全对齐弱点的综合测试框架。它通过一种系统化的句子配对探索策略来构建越狱提示。实验证明，SPELL能有效突破GPT-4.1、Claude-3.5和Qwen2.5-Coder等先进代码模型的安全限制，成功生成并执行恶意代码，揭示了当前AI代码生成工具中存在的严重安全差距。
AI.keywords: LLM安全, 恶意代码生成, 越狱测试, SPELL框架, 安全对齐
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一个专注于恶意代码生成的安全对齐测试框架SPELL，填补了现有通用越狱研究的空白。其重要性在于揭示了当前先进LLM在代码生成安全对齐方面的显著漏洞。局限性在于测试结果依赖于特定的“先验知识数据集”和“时间-分割选择策略”。

title: SegMo: Segment-aligned Text to 3D Human Motion Generation
comments: The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026
summary: Generating 3D human motions from textual descriptions is an important research problem with broad applications in video games, virtual reality, and augmented reality. Recent methods align the textual description with human motion at the sequence level, neglecting the internal semantic structure of modalities. However, both motion descriptions and motion sequences can be naturally decomposed into smaller and semantically coherent segments, which can serve as atomic alignment units to achieve finer-grained correspondence. Motivated by this, we propose SegMo, a novel Segment-aligned text-conditioned human Motion generation framework to achieve fine-grained text-motion alignment. Our framework consists of three modules: (1) Text Segment Extraction, which decomposes complex textual descriptions into temporally ordered phrases, each representing a simple atomic action; (2) Motion Segment Extraction, which partitions complete motion sequences into corresponding motion segments; and (3) Fine-grained Text-Motion Alignment, which aligns text and motion segments with contrastive learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SegMo improves the strong baseline on two widely used datasets, achieving an improved TOP 1 score of 0.553 on the HumanML3D test set. Moreover, thanks to the learned shared embedding space for text and motion segments, SegMo can also be applied to retrieval-style tasks such as motion grounding and motion-to-text retrieval.
comment: The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026

AI.title_translation: 分段对齐的文本到三维人体运动生成
AI.tldr: SegMo通过将文本和运动分解为语义段，实现了更细粒度的文本-运动对齐，从而提高了3D人体运动生成质量，并可用于检索任务。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在序列级别对齐文本和运动，忽略了它们各自的内部语义结构。而文本描述和运动序列都可以自然地分解为更小的、语义连贯的段，这些段可以作为原子对齐单元，实现更细粒度的对应。因此，需要一种能够实现细粒度文本-运动对齐的框架。
AI.method: SegMo框架包含三个模块：1. 文本段提取：将文本描述分解为按时间顺序排列的短语，每个短语代表一个简单的原子动作。2. 运动段提取：将完整的运动序列分割成相应的运动段。3. 细粒度文本-运动对齐：利用对比学习对齐文本和运动段。
AI.result: SegMo在两个常用数据集上显著优于强基线模型，在HumanML3D测试集上取得了0.553的改进TOP 1分数。此外，由于学习到了文本和运动段的共享嵌入空间，SegMo还可以应用于运动定位和运动到文本检索等检索式任务。
AI.conclusion: SegMo通过引入段对齐实现了细粒度的文本-运动对应，提高了3D人体运动生成的质量，并且能够支持检索任务。
AI.translation: 从文本描述生成3D人体运动是一个重要的研究问题，在电子游戏、虚拟现实和增强现实中有广泛的应用。最近的方法在序列级别上对齐文本描述和人体运动，忽略了模态的内部语义结构。然而，运动描述和运动序列都可以自然地分解成更小、语义上连贯的段，这些段可以作为原子对齐单元，以实现更细粒度的对应。受此启发，我们提出了SegMo，一个新颖的、分段对齐的文本条件人体运动生成框架，以实现细粒度的文本-运动对齐。我们的框架包含三个模块：(1) 文本段提取，它将复杂的文本描述分解成时间顺序排列的短语，每个短语代表一个简单的原子动作；(2) 运动段提取，它将完整的运动序列分割成相应的运动段；(3) 细粒度文本-运动对齐，它利用对比学习对齐文本和运动段。大量实验表明，SegMo在两个广泛使用的数据集上改进了强基线模型，在HumanML3D测试集上取得了0.553的改进TOP 1分数。此外，得益于学习到的文本和运动段的共享嵌入空间，SegMo还可以应用于运动定位和运动到文本检索等检索式任务。
AI.summary: SegMo是一个新颖的框架，通过将文本描述和3D人体运动分割成语义段，并利用对比学习进行细粒度对齐，从而实现了更精确的文本到3D人体运动生成。该方法在HumanML3D数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，并且由于其共享嵌入空间，还可以用于运动定位和运动到文本检索等任务。
AI.keywords: 3D人体运动生成, 文本条件生成, 段对齐, 对比学习, 运动检索
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的SegMo框架，通过引入文本和运动的段级对齐来解决现有方法在序列级对齐上的不足，实现了更细粒度的文本-运动对应，从而提高了3D人体运动生成的质量。其在检索任务上的应用也展示了该方法的灵活性和潜力。然而，段提取的准确性和鲁棒性可能是未来研究需要关注的方面。

title: Assessing the Software Security Comprehension of Large Language Models
comments: Submitted to Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE) journal
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software development, but their level of software security expertise remains unclear. This work systematically evaluates the security comprehension of five leading LLMs: GPT-4o-Mini, GPT-5-Mini, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Llama-3.1, and Qwen-2.5, using Blooms Taxonomy as a framework. We assess six cognitive dimensions: remembering, understanding, applying, analyzing, evaluating, and creating. Our methodology integrates diverse datasets, including curated multiple-choice questions, vulnerable code snippets (SALLM), course assessments from an Introduction to Software Security course, real-world case studies (XBOW), and project-based creation tasks from a Secure Software Engineering course. Results show that while LLMs perform well on lower-level cognitive tasks such as recalling facts and identifying known vulnerabilities, their performance degrades significantly on higher-order tasks that require reasoning, architectural evaluation, and secure system creation. Beyond reporting aggregate accuracy, we introduce a software security knowledge boundary that identifies the highest cognitive level at which a model consistently maintains reliable performance. In addition, we identify 51 recurring misconception patterns exhibited by LLMs across Blooms levels.
comment: Submitted to Empirical Software Engineering (EMSE) journal

AI.title_translation: 评估大型语言模型对软件安全的理解程度
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用布鲁姆分类法和多种数据集，测试了五种主流LLMs（如GPT-4o-Mini, Llama-3.1等）的软件安全知识水平。发现它们擅长记忆和识别漏洞，但在推理、评估和创建安全系统等复杂任务上表现不佳，并确定了它们的知识能力上限和常见错误模式。
AI.motivation: 鉴于大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件开发中应用日益广泛，但其在软件安全方面的专业知识水平尚不明确，因此需要对这些模型的安全理解能力进行系统性评估。
AI.method: 使用布鲁姆分类法（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评估、创建六个认知维度）对GPT-4o-Mini、GPT-5-Mini、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Llama-3.1和Qwen-2.5五种主流LLM进行系统评估。评估数据集包括精选的多项选择题、易受攻击的代码片段（SALLM）、软件安全课程的评估题、真实案例研究（XBOW）以及安全软件工程课程的项目创建任务。
AI.result: LLMs在较低层次的认知任务（如事实回忆和识别已知漏洞）上表现良好，但在需要推理、架构评估和安全系统创建等高阶任务上的性能显著下降。研究引入了“软件安全知识边界”来确定模型可靠性能维持的最高认知水平，并识别出LLMs在不同布鲁姆层次上表现出的51种重复出现的误解模式。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在回忆事实和识别已知漏洞等较低认知任务上表现良好，但在需要推理、架构评估和安全系统创建等高阶任务上的表现显著下降。研究确定了模型可靠性能维持的最高认知水平（知识边界），并识别出51种重复出现的误解模式。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地应用于软件开发中，但它们在软件安全方面的专业知识水平仍不清楚。这项工作系统地评估了五种主流LLMs：GPT-4o-Mini、GPT-5-Mini、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Llama-3.1和Qwen-2.5的安全理解能力，并以布鲁姆分类法作为框架。我们评估了六个认知维度：记忆、理解、应用、分析、评估和创建。我们的方法整合了多样化的数据集，包括精选的多项选择题、易受攻击的代码片段（SALLM）、来自“软件安全导论”课程的考试评估、真实案例研究（XBOW）以及来自“安全软件工程”课程的项目创建任务。结果表明，虽然LLMs在回忆事实和识别已知漏洞等较低层次的认知任务上表现良好，但其在需要推理、架构评估和安全系统创建等高阶任务上的性能显著下降。除了报告总体准确率外，我们引入了一个软件安全知识边界，用于识别模型能够持续保持可靠性能的最高认知水平。此外，我们还识别出LLMs在所有布鲁姆层次上表现出的51种重复出现的误解模式。
AI.summary: 本研究系统地评估了五种主流大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件安全理解方面的能力，采用布鲁姆分类法（六个认知维度）作为评估框架，并结合了多源数据集（包括选择题、漏洞代码、课程评估和项目任务）。结果显示，LLMs在低阶认知任务上表现尚可，但在需要高级推理和系统创建的高阶任务上性能显著下降。研究进一步定义了模型的“软件安全知识边界”，并揭示了模型普遍存在的51种安全误解模式。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 软件安全, 布鲁姆分类法, 认知能力, 知识边界
AI.comments: 该研究系统地评估了主流LLM在软件安全理解方面的能力，采用布鲁姆分类法作为框架，具有很强的系统性和全面性。主要创新点在于引入了“软件安全知识边界”的概念来量化模型的可靠性能上限，并识别出模型普遍存在的误解模式。限制是评估仅基于特定数据集和任务，实际应用中的表现可能有所不同。

title: Improving the Convergence Rate of Ray Search Optimization for Query-Efficient Hard-Label Attacks
comments: Published at AAAI 2026 (Oral). This version corresponds to the conference proceedings; v2 will include the appendix
summary: In hard-label black-box adversarial attacks, where only the top-1 predicted label is accessible, the prohibitive query complexity poses a major obstacle to practical deployment. In this paper, we focus on optimizing a representative class of attacks that search for the optimal ray direction yielding the minimum $\ell_2$-norm perturbation required to move a benign image into the adversarial region. Inspired by Nesterov's Accelerated Gradient (NAG), we propose a momentum-based algorithm, ARS-OPT, which proactively estimates the gradient with respect to a future ray direction inferred from accumulated momentum. We provide a theoretical analysis of its convergence behavior, showing that ARS-OPT enables more accurate directional updates and achieves faster, more stable optimization. To further accelerate convergence, we incorporate surrogate-model priors into ARS-OPT's gradient estimation, resulting in PARS-OPT with enhanced performance. The superiority of our approach is supported by theoretical guarantees under standard assumptions. Extensive experiments on ImageNet and CIFAR-10 demonstrate that our method surpasses 13 state-of-the-art approaches in query efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 改进查询高效硬标签攻击的射线搜索优化收敛速度
AI.tldr: 为了解决硬标签黑盒攻击查询成本过高的问题，研究人员借鉴NAG提出了动量加速的射线搜索优化算法（ARS-OPT/PARS-OPT），通过预测未来梯度和引入先验知识，显著提高了攻击的查询效率，并在标准数据集上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: 硬标签黑盒对抗攻击中，仅能获取Top-1预测标签，这导致了高昂的查询复杂度，阻碍了其实际应用。研究的动机是优化一类搜索最优射线方向的攻击方法，以最小化$\ell_2$范数扰动。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于动量的算法ARS-OPT，它主动估计相对于由累积动量推断出的未来射线方向的梯度。进一步提出了PARS-OPT，通过将替代模型先验知识整合到梯度估计中以进一步加速收敛。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，ARS-OPT实现了更准确的方向更新，达到了更快、更稳定的优化。PARS-OPT表现出增强的性能。实验证明，该方法在ImageNet和CIFAR-10上优于13种最先进的方法在查询效率方面。
AI.conclusion: ARS-OPT和PARS-OPT通过动量加速和引入先验知识，实现了更准确的方向更新和更快、更稳定的优化，在查询效率上超越了现有的13种最先进方法。
AI.translation: 在硬标签黑盒对抗攻击中，仅能获取Top-1预测标签，高昂的查询复杂度是其实际部署的主要障碍。本文专注于优化一类代表性的攻击，即搜索能产生将良性图像推入对抗区域所需的最小$\ell_2$范数扰动的最优射线方向。受Nesterov加速梯度（NAG）的启发，我们提出了一种基于动量的算法ARS-OPT，它主动估计相对于由累积动量推断出的未来射线方向的梯度。我们对其收敛行为进行了理论分析，表明ARS-OPT能够实现更准确的方向更新，并达到更快、更稳定的优化。为了进一步加速收敛，我们将替代模型先验知识整合到ARS-OPT的梯度估计中，形成了PARS-OPT，从而提升了性能。我们的方法的优越性得到了标准假设下的理论保证支持。在ImageNet和CIFAR-10上的广泛实验证明，我们的方法在查询效率上超越了13种最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对硬标签黑盒对抗攻击中查询效率低下的问题，提出了一种基于Nesterov加速梯度的动量化算法ARS-OPT，用于优化射线搜索攻击，以最小化$\ell_2$扰动。通过理论分析证明了其收敛速度的提升。进一步引入先验知识得到PARS-OPT。实验结果表明，该方法在查询效率上显著优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.keywords: 硬标签攻击, 查询效率, 射线搜索, Nesterov加速梯度, 对抗攻击
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将Nesterov加速梯度（NAG）的思想引入到基于射线搜索的黑盒对抗攻击中，提出了ARS-OPT及其增强版PARS-OPT，有效解决了硬标签攻击中查询效率低下的核心问题。其理论分析和广泛的实验结果（在ImageNet和CIFAR-10上超越13种SOTA方法）证明了其重要性。局限性在于，其理论保证可能依赖于标准的未明确说明的假设。

title: LookPlanGraph: Embodied Instruction Following Method with VLM Graph Augmentation
summary: Methods that use Large Language Models (LLM) as planners for embodied instruction following tasks have become widespread. To successfully complete tasks, the LLM must be grounded in the environment in which the robot operates. One solution is to use a scene graph that contains all the necessary information. Modern methods rely on prebuilt scene graphs and assume that all task-relevant information is available at the start of planning. However, these approaches do not account for changes in the environment that may occur between the graph construction and the task execution. We propose LookPlanGraph - a method that leverages a scene graph composed of static assets and object priors. During plan execution, LookPlanGraph continuously updates the graph with relevant objects, either by verifying existing priors or discovering new entities. This is achieved by processing the agents egocentric camera view using a Vision Language Model. We conducted experiments with changed object positions VirtualHome and OmniGibson simulated environments, demonstrating that LookPlanGraph outperforms methods based on predefined static scene graphs. To demonstrate the practical applicability of our approach, we also conducted experiments in a real-world setting. Additionally, we introduce the GraSIF (Graph Scenes for Instruction Following) dataset with automated validation framework, comprising 514 tasks drawn from SayPlan Office, BEHAVIOR-1K, and VirtualHome RobotHow. Project page available at https://lookplangraph.github.io .

AI.title_translation: 视觉语言模型图增强的具身指令跟随方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为LookPlanGraph的方法，用于解决具身指令跟随任务中，LLM规划器需要与机器人操作环境进行关联的问题。与依赖预先构建的静态场景图的方法不同，LookPlanGraph在计划执行过程中，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）不断更新场景图，以适应环境变化。实验证明，该方法在模拟和真实环境中均优于静态场景图方法，并引入了包含514个任务的新数据集GraSIF。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的具身指令跟随方法依赖于场景图，但这些场景图通常是预先构建的，无法处理在任务执行过程中环境发生的变化。
AI.method: LookPlanGraph方法利用一个包含静态资产和对象先验知识的场景图。在执行计划时，通过处理机器人的主视角图像并利用视觉语言模型（VLM），该方法能够持续更新场景图，验证现有先验知识或发现新实体。
AI.result: 在VirtualHome和OmniGibson模拟环境中，LookPlanGraph在对象位置发生变化的情况下，优于基于预定义静态场景图的方法。该方法也在真实世界环境中进行了实验，并引入了GraSIF数据集，包含514个任务。
AI.conclusion: LookPlanGraph通过动态更新场景图，能够有效地处理具身指令跟随任务中的环境变化，并在模拟和真实环境中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 使用大型语言模型（LLM）作为规划器进行具身指令跟随任务的方法已经变得普遍。为了成功完成任务，LLM必须与机器人运行的环境相关联。一种解决方案是使用包含所有必要信息的场景图。现代方法依赖于预先构建的场景图，并假设在规划开始时所有与任务相关的信息都可用。然而，这些方法没有考虑到在图构建和任务执行之间可能发生的环境变化。我们提出了LookPlanGraph——一种利用由静态资产和对象先验组成的场景图的方法。在计划执行期间，LookPlanGraph通过验证现有先验或发现新实体，不断用相关对象更新场景图。这是通过使用视觉语言模型处理代理的主视角相机视图来实现的。我们在VirtualHome和OmniGibson模拟环境中进行了对象位置发生变化的情况下进行的实验，证明LookPlanGraph的性能优于基于预定义静态场景图的方法。为了展示我们方法的实际适用性，我们还在真实世界环境中进行了实验。此外，我们引入了GraSIF（用于指令跟随的图场景）数据集，该数据集包含一个自动验证框架，由来自SayPlan Office、BEHAVIOR-1K和VirtualHome RobotHow的514个任务组成。项目页面可在https://lookplangraph.github.io 获取。
AI.summary: LookPlanGraph是一种创新的具身指令跟随方法，它通过利用视觉语言模型（VLM）动态增强和更新场景图，解决了传统方法中场景图静态化的局限性。该方法在规划执行过程中能够适应环境变化，并在模拟和真实世界环境中均表现出优越的性能，同时还引入了新的数据集GraSIF以促进该领域的研究。
AI.keywords: 具身指令跟随, 场景图, 大型语言模型, 视觉语言模型, 动态更新
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为LookPlanGraph的新颖方法，通过动态更新场景图来解决具身指令跟随任务中的环境变化问题，这在理论和实践上都具有重要意义。该方法利用VLM处理代理的视角，实现了场景信息的实时更新，有效弥补了传统静态场景图方法的不足。引入GraSIF数据集及其自动验证框架，为该领域的研究提供了宝贵的资源。然而，该方法在处理复杂动态环境或需要精细操作的任务时，其鲁棒性和效率仍有待进一步验证。

title: ARX-Implementation of encrypted nonlinear dynamic controllers using observer form
summary: While computation-enabled cryptosystems applied to control systems have improved security and privacy, a major issue is that the number of recursive operations on encrypted data is limited to a finite number of times in most cases, especially where fast computation is required. To allow for nonlinear dynamic control under this constraint, a method for representing a state-space system model as an auto-regressive model with exogenous inputs (ARX model) is proposed. With the input as well as the output of the plant encrypted and transmitted to the controller, the reformulated ARX form can compute each output using only a finite number of operations, from its several previous inputs and outputs. Existence of a stable observer for the controller is a key condition for the proposed representation. The representation replaces the controller with an observer form and applies a method similar to finite-impulse-response approximation. It is verified that the approximation error and its effect can be made arbitrarily small by an appropriate choice of a parameter, under stability of the observer and the closed-loop system. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: 加密非线性动态控制器基于观察器形式的ARX实现
AI.tldr: 为了在加密控制中克服有限递归操作的限制，研究人员提出将系统模型转换为ARX形式。这样，控制器就可以在加密数据上使用有限次运算来计算输出。该方法要求观察器稳定，并通过仿真证明了有效性。
AI.motivation: 在大多数情况下，尤其是在需要快速计算时，应用于控制系统的计算加密系统对加密数据的递归操作次数仅限于有限次数，这是一个主要问题。为了在这种约束下实现非线性动态控制，需要新的表示方法。
AI.method: 提出一种将状态空间系统模型表示为带有外生输入的自回归模型（ARX模型）的方法；将控制器替换为观察器形式，并应用类似于有限脉冲响应近似的方法。
AI.result: 所提出的表示法可以仅使用其先前几个输入和输出来计算每个输出，并且通过适当选择参数，可以在观察器和闭环系统稳定的条件下使近似误差及其影响任意小。
AI.conclusion: 仿真结果证明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.translation: 虽然应用于控制系统的计算加密系统提高了安全性和隐私性，但一个主要问题是，在大多数情况下，尤其是在需要快速计算的情况下，对加密数据的递归操作次数仅限于有限次数。为了在这种约束下实现非线性动态控制，提出了一种将状态空间系统模型表示为带有外生输入的自回归模型（ARX模型）的方法。当植物的输入和输出都被加密并传输到控制器时，重新构造的ARX形式仅使用其先前几个输入和输出来计算每个输出。控制器存在稳定观察器是所提出表示的关键条件。该表示用观察器形式替换了控制器，并应用了类似于有限脉冲响应近似的方法。经验证，在观察器和闭环系统稳定的条件下，通过适当选择参数，可以使近似误差及其影响任意小。仿真结果证明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 为解决加密控制中有限递归操作的限制，本文提出了一种将状态空间系统模型重构为ARX模型的方法。该方法允许在加密输入和输出下进行非线性动态控制，仅需有限次数的操作。该方法依赖于控制器稳定观察器的存在，并通过类似FIR近似的方法实现，仿真验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 加密控制, ARX模型, 非线性动态控制器, 观察器形式, 有限递归操作
AI.comments: 该方法的创新点在于使用ARX模型来解决加密控制系统中有限递归操作的限制，这在需要快速计算的场景中非常重要。其重要性在于为安全和隐私保护下的非线性动态控制提供了一种可行的计算方案。限制可能在于对稳定观察器的依赖性。

title: Learning Factors in AI-Augmented Education: A Comparative Study of Middle and High School Students
summary: The increasing integration of AI tools in education has led prior research to explore their impact on learning processes. Nevertheless, most existing studies focus on higher education and conventional instructional contexts, leaving open questions about how key learning factors are related in AI-mediated learning environments and how these relationships may vary across different age groups. Addressing these gaps, our work investigates whether four critical learning factors, experience, clarity, comfort, and motivation, maintain coherent interrelationships in AI-augmented educational settings, and how the structure of these relationships differs between middle and high school students. The study was conducted in authentic classroom contexts where students interacted with AI tools as part of programming learning activities to collect data on the four learning factors and students' perceptions. Using a multimethod quantitative analysis, which combined correlation analysis and text mining, we revealed markedly different dimensional structures between the two age groups. Middle school students exhibit strong positive correlations across all dimensions, indicating holistic evaluation patterns whereby positive perceptions in one dimension generalise to others. In contrast, high school students show weak or near-zero correlations between key dimensions, suggesting a more differentiated evaluation process in which dimensions are assessed independently. These findings reveal that perception dimensions actively mediate AI-augmented learning and that the developmental stage moderates their interdependencies. This work establishes a foundation for the development of AI integration strategies that respond to learners' developmental levels and account for age-specific dimensional structures in student-AI interactions.

AI.title_translation: 人工智能辅助教育中的学习因素：一项针对初中生和高中生的比较研究
AI.tldr: AI辅助学习中，初中生对经验、清晰度、舒适度和动机的感知是相互关联的（整体评估），而高中生则倾向于独立评估（分化评估）。发展阶段影响了这些因素的相互依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多集中在高等教育和传统教学环境中，忽略了关键学习因素在AI中介学习环境中的关系以及这些关系在不同年龄组之间的差异。
AI.method: 采用多方法定量分析，结合了相关性分析和文本挖掘，在真实的课堂环境中进行，学生将AI工具作为编程学习活动的一部分进行互动。
AI.result: 研究揭示了两个年龄组之间存在明显不同的维度结构。初中生在所有维度上表现出强烈的正相关关系，表明存在整体评估模式；而高中生在关键维度之间表现出弱或接近零的相关性，表明评估过程更加分化和独立。
AI.conclusion: 感知维度会积极地调节AI辅助学习，并且学习者的发展阶段调节了这些维度的相互依赖性。这项工作为制定响应学习者发展水平并考虑学生-AI交互中特定年龄维度结构的人工智能整合策略奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 人工智能工具在教育中的日益融合促使以往的研究探索其对学习过程的影响。然而，大多数现有研究都集中在高等教育和传统的教学环境中，留下了关于关键学习因素如何在AI中介的学习环境中相互关联，以及这些关系如何随不同年龄组而变化的问题。为解决这些空白，我们的工作调查了经验、清晰度、舒适度和动机这四个关键学习因素在人工智能辅助教育环境中是否保持一致的相互关系，以及这种关系结构在初中生和高中生之间有何不同。本研究在真实的课堂环境中进行，学生将AI工具作为编程学习活动的一部分进行互动，以收集关于这四个学习因素和学生感知的“数据”。使用多方法定量分析，结合相关性分析和文本挖掘，我们揭示了两个年龄组之间存在明显不同的维度结构。初中生在所有维度上表现出强烈的正相关关系，表明存在整体评估模式，即一个维度的积极感知会泛化到其他维度。相比之下，高中生在关键维度之间表现出弱或接近零的相关性，表明评估过程更加分化，维度是独立评估的。这些发现表明，感知维度会积极地调节AI辅助学习，并且发展阶段调节了这些相互依赖性。这项工作为制定响应学习者发展水平并考虑学生-AI交互中特定年龄维度结构的人工智能整合策略奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了初中生和高中生在使用AI辅助编程学习时，经验、清晰度、舒适度和动机这四个关键学习因素之间的关系结构有何不同。通过定量分析，发现初中生对这些因素的评估是整体性的（强正相关），而高中生则更为分化（弱相关）。研究表明，学习者的发展阶段调节了这些感知维度的相互依赖性，为定制AI整合策略提供了依据。
AI.keywords: 人工智能教育, 学习因素, 年龄差异, 结构关系, 评估模式
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于首次比较了中学生和高中生在使用人工智能辅助学习时，四个关键学习因素（经验、清晰度、舒适度和动机）之间关系结构的差异。其重要性在于为制定针对不同发展阶段学习者的AI整合策略奠定了基础。局限性在于研究仅限于编程学习活动中的AI工具。

title: Industrial Ouroboros: Deep Lateral Movement via Living Off the Plant
summary: Lateral movement is a tactic that adversaries employ most frequently in enterprise IT environments to traverse between assets. In operational technology (OT) environments, however, few methods exist for lateral movement between domain-specific devices, particularly programmable logic controllers (PLCs). Existing techniques often rely on complex chains of vulnerabilities, which are noisy and can be patched. This paper describes the first PLC-centric lateral movement technique that relies exclusively on the native functionality of the victim environment. This OT-specific form of `living off the land' is herein distinguished as `living off the plant' (LOTP). The described technique also facilitates escape from IP networks onto legacy serial networks via dual-homed PLCs. Furthermore, this technique is covert, leveraging common network communication functions that are challenging to detect. This serves as a reminder of the risks posed by LOTP techniques within OT, highlighting the need for a fundamental reconsideration of traditional OT defensive practices.

AI.title_translation: 工业衔尾蛇：通过“植被式生存”实现的深度横向移动
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种名为“植被式生存”（LOTP）的OT（操作技术）横向移动攻击方法，它不依赖漏洞，而是直接利用PLC的内置功能进行隐蔽移动，甚至能跨越不同类型的网络，这对现有的OT防御策略构成了严峻挑战。
AI.motivation: 企业IT环境中横向移动战术使用频繁，但在操作技术（OT）环境中，尤其是在可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）之间，缺乏有效的横向移动方法，现有技术依赖于易被修补且易被察觉的复杂漏洞链。
AI.method: 描述了一种完全依赖受害者环境原生功能的PLC中心化横向移动技术，并指出该技术可以利用双宿主PLC从IP网络逃逸到传统串行网络。
AI.result: 描述了首个PLC中心的横向移动技术，该技术是OT特有的“植被式生存”（LOTP），它隐蔽且利用常见的网络通信功能，并能实现网络逃逸。
AI.conclusion: LOTP技术对OT环境构成了风险，需要对传统的OT防御实践进行根本性的重新考虑。
AI.translation: 横向移动是攻击者在企业IT环境中进行资产间穿梭时最常用的战术。然而，在操作技术（OT）环境中，用于在特定领域的设备之间，特别是可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）之间进行横向移动的方法很少。现有技术通常依赖于复杂的漏洞链，这些漏洞链会产生噪音并且可能被修补。本文描述了首个以PLC为中心的横向移动技术，它完全依赖于受害者环境的原生功能。这种OT特有的“靠活环境生存”的形式在此被称为“植被式生存”（LOTP）。所描述的技术还通过双宿主的PLC促进了从IP网络到遗留串行网络的逃逸。此外，该技术是隐蔽的，利用了难以检测的常见网络通信功能。这提醒人们注意LOTP技术在OT环境中带来的风险，凸显了对传统OT防御实践进行根本性重新考虑的必要性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了“工业衔尾蛇”——一种专为操作技术（OT）环境设计的、基于PLC的横向移动技术，称为“植被式生存”（LOTP）。该技术完全利用受害者环境的原生功能，从而比依赖漏洞链的现有方法更隐蔽，并且能够通过双宿主PLC实现从IP网络到传统串行网络的逃逸。这突显了LOTP技术在OT安全防御中的重要性和挑战性。
AI.keywords: 横向移动, 可编程逻辑控制器, 操作技术, 植被式生存, 网络安全
AI.comments: 该论文提出了“植被式生存”（LOTP）这一针对操作技术（OT）环境的新型横向移动技术，其创新点在于完全利用受害者环境的本地功能，避免了对复杂漏洞链的依赖，使得攻击更隐蔽。其重要性在于揭示了OT环境中利用原生功能进行隐蔽攻击的风险，对传统OT防御提出了挑战。局限性是仅基于PLC，可能未涵盖所有OT设备。

title: CoTDeceptor:Adversarial Code Obfuscation Against CoT-Enhanced LLM Code Agents
summary: LLM-based code agents(e.g., ChatGPT Codex) are increasingly deployed as detector for code review and security auditing tasks. Although CoT-enhanced LLM vulnerability detectors are believed to provide improved robustness against obfuscated malicious code, we find that their reasoning chains and semantic abstraction processes exhibit exploitable systematic weaknesses.This allows attackers to covertly embed malicious logic, bypass code review, and propagate backdoored components throughout real-world software supply chains.To investigate this issue, we present CoTDeceptor, the first adversarial code obfuscation framework targeting CoT-enhanced LLM detectors. CoTDeceptor autonomously constructs evolving, hard-to-reverse multi-stage obfuscation strategy chains that effectively disrupt CoT-driven detection logic.We obtained malicious code provided by security enterprise, experimental results demonstrate that CoTDeceptor achieves stable and transferable evasion performance against state-of-the-art LLMs and vulnerability detection agents. CoTDeceptor bypasses 14 out of 15 vulnerability categories, compared to only 2 bypassed by prior methods. Our findings highlight potential risks in real-world software supply chains and underscore the need for more robust and interpretable LLM-powered security analysis systems.

AI.title_translation: CoTDeceptor：针对CoT增强的LLM代码代理的对抗性代码混淆
AI.tldr: CoTDeceptor是一个新的对抗性代码混淆框架，它能有效地绕过基于CoT的LLM代码审查工具，并在实际应用中展现出显著的规避能力，表明当前LLM在安全审计方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代码代理在代码审查和安全审计中的应用日益广泛，现有技术（特别是CoT增强的LLM）在检测混淆恶意代码方面被认为具有鲁棒性，但其推理链和语义抽象过程存在可利用的系统性弱点。这为攻击者提供了一个潜在的途径来规避检测，将恶意代码植入软件供应链。
AI.method: 提出CoTDeceptor框架，该框架能够自主地构建演进的、难以逆转的多阶段混淆策略链，以扰乱CoT驱动的检测逻辑。该框架利用了安全企业提供的恶意代码进行实验。
AI.result: CoTDeceptor在实验中表现出稳定且可迁移的规避性能，能够绕过15个漏洞类别中的14个，而先前的方法只能绕过2个。这表明CoTDeceptor在对抗先进的LLM和漏洞检测代理方面非常有效。
AI.conclusion: CoTDeceptor的成功表明，即使是CoT增强的LLM在代码安全审计方面也存在显著的风险，其推理过程中的系统性弱点可能被利用。这强调了在现实世界的软件供应链中存在潜在的安全风险，并迫切需要开发更强大、更可解释的LLM驱动的安全分析系统。
AI.translation: 基于LLM的代码代理（例如ChatGPT Codex）越来越多地被部署用于代码审查和安全审计任务。尽管人们认为CoT增强的LLM漏洞检测器能提供对混淆恶意代码的改进鲁棒性，但我们发现它们的推理链和语义抽象过程存在可利用的系统性弱点。这使得攻击者能够秘密地嵌入恶意逻辑，绕过代码审查，并将后门组件传播到整个真实世界的软件供应链中。为了研究这个问题，我们提出了CoTDeceptor，这是第一个针对CoT增强的LLM检测器的对抗性代码混淆框架。CoTDeceptor自主构建演进的、难以逆转的多阶段混淆策略链，这些策略能有效地扰乱CoT驱动的检测逻辑。我们使用了安全企业提供的恶意代码，实验结果表明，CoTDeceptor在对抗最先进的LLM和漏洞检测代理方面取得了稳定且可迁移的规避性能。与先前方法仅能绕过2个漏洞类别相比，CoTDeceptor绕过了15个漏洞类别中的14个。我们的研究结果凸显了真实世界软件供应链中的潜在风险，并强调了对更强大、更可解释的LLM驱动的安全分析系统的需求。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了CoTDeceptor，一个首创的对抗性代码混淆框架，专门针对利用CoT（思维链）增强的LLM代码代理。研究发现，尽管CoT增强的LLM在代码审计中被认为能有效检测混淆代码，但其推理过程存在系统性弱点。CoTDeceptor利用这些弱点，自主生成复杂的多阶段混淆策略，成功绕过先进的LLM代码代理，在实验中绕过了14种漏洞中的13种。这揭示了当前LLM在软件供应链安全中的潜在风险，并强调了开发更鲁棒、更可解释的安全分析系统的必要性。
AI.keywords: 代码混淆, LLM代码代理, CoT增强, 对抗性攻击, 软件供应链安全
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了当前LLM在代码安全审计领域的一个重要且新颖的攻击向量，即利用CoT推理过程中的系统性弱点。CoTDeceptor框架的自主性和多阶段混淆策略是其亮点，展示了对抗性攻击的复杂性和有效性。然而，该研究也指出了当前LLM在安全应用中的局限性，并强调了对更可靠、更透明的安全分析工具的需求。未来的研究可以关注如何增强LLM的鲁棒性，以抵御此类对抗性攻击，以及开发更有效的检测机制。

title: Uncertainty in security: managing cyber senescence
summary: My main worry, and the core of my research, is that our cybersecurity ecosystem is slowly but surely aging and getting old and that aging is becoming an operational risk. This is happening not only because of growing complexity, but more importantly because of accumulation of controls and measures whose effectiveness are uncertain. I introduce a new term for this aging phenomenon: cyber senescence. I will begin my lecture with a short historical overview in which I sketch a development over time that led to this worry for the future of cybersecurity. It is this worry that determined my research agenda and its central theme of the role of uncertainty in cybersecurity. My worry is that waste is accumulating in cyberspace. This waste consists of a multitude of overlapping controls whose risk reductions are uncertain. Unless we start pruning these control frameworks, this waste accumulation causes aging of cyberspace and could ultimately lead to a system collapse.

AI.title_translation: 安全中的不确定性：管理网络衰老
AI.tldr: 网络安全系统因过多且效果不确定的安全控制措施而正在老化（网络衰老），这是一种操作风险，需要修剪以防系统崩溃。
AI.motivation: 核心担忧是网络安全生态系统正在缓慢老化并成为操作风险，这不仅是由于日益增长的复杂性，更重要的是由于有效性不确定的控制措施的累积。
AI.method: 通过历史回顾来勾勒导致当前担忧的发展轨迹，并引入“网络衰老”这一概念来描述现象。
AI.result: 指出了网络空间中正在积累“浪费”，即大量重叠且风险降低效果不确定的控制措施，这正在导致网络空间的衰老。
AI.conclusion: 如果不开始修剪这些控制框架，这种浪费的积累将导致网络空间的衰老，并最终可能导致系统崩溃。
AI.translation: 我的主要担忧，也是我研究的核心，是我们网络安全生态系统正在缓慢而确实地老化，并且这种老化正在成为一种操作风险。这不仅是由于日益增长的复杂性，更重要的是由于累积了有效性不确定的控制和措施。我为这种老龄化现象引入了一个新术语：网络衰老（cyber senescence）。我的讲座将以简短的历史回顾开始，勾勒出导致对网络安全未来担忧的发展轨迹。正是这种担忧决定了我的研究议程及其核心主题——不确定性在网络安全中的作用。我的担忧是，网络空间中正在积累浪费。这种浪费由大量重叠且风险降低效果不确定的控制措施组成。除非我们开始修剪这些控制框架，否则这种浪费的积累将导致网络空间的衰老，并最终可能导致系统崩溃。
AI.summary: 本文的核心观点是引入“网络衰老”这一术语来描述网络安全系统中因控制措施过度累积且效果不确定而导致的系统性老化现象，并警告如果不加以清理，这种累积可能导致系统崩溃。
AI.keywords: 网络安全, 风险管理, 衰老, 控制累积, 不确定性
AI.comments: 本文提出了“网络衰老”（cyber senescence）这一新概念，强调了安全控制措施的累积和不确定性带来的系统性风险，具有很强的警示意义和前瞻性。其局限性在于，摘要主要描述了问题和担忧，缺乏具体的解决方案或量化分析。

title: DreaMontage: Arbitrary Frame-Guided One-Shot Video Generation
summary: The "one-shot" technique represents a distinct and sophisticated aesthetic in filmmaking. However, its practical realization is often hindered by prohibitive costs and complex real-world constraints. Although emerging video generation models offer a virtual alternative, existing approaches typically rely on naive clip concatenation, which frequently fails to maintain visual smoothness and temporal coherence. In this paper, we introduce DreaMontage, a comprehensive framework designed for arbitrary frame-guided generation, capable of synthesizing seamless, expressive, and long-duration one-shot videos from diverse user-provided inputs. To achieve this, we address the challenge through three primary dimensions. (i) We integrate a lightweight intermediate-conditioning mechanism into the DiT architecture. By employing an Adaptive Tuning strategy that effectively leverages base training data, we unlock robust arbitrary-frame control capabilities. (ii) To enhance visual fidelity and cinematic expressiveness, we curate a high-quality dataset and implement a Visual Expression SFT stage. In addressing critical issues such as subject motion rationality and transition smoothness, we apply a Tailored DPO scheme, which significantly improves the success rate and usability of the generated content. (iii) To facilitate the production of extended sequences, we design a Segment-wise Auto-Regressive (SAR) inference strategy that operates in a memory-efficient manner. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves visually striking and seamlessly coherent one-shot effects while maintaining computational efficiency, empowering users to transform fragmented visual materials into vivid, cohesive one-shot cinematic experiences.

AI.title_translation: 任意帧引导的一次性视频生成
AI.tldr: DreaMontage是一个框架，可以通过任意帧引导来生成无缝、富有表现力、长时的一次性视频，解决了现有方法中视觉不连贯和时间不连贯的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成模型在生成一次性视频时，常采用简单的片段拼接，导致视觉不连贯和时间不连贯。DreaMontage旨在克服这些限制，生成流畅、富有表现力且长期的单次视频。
AI.method: 1. 集成轻量级中间条件机制到DiT架构中，采用自适应调优策略实现任意帧控制。2. 策划高质量数据集，实施视觉表达SFT阶段，并应用定制DPO方案解决主体运动合理性和过渡平滑性问题。3. 设计了内存高效的分段自回归（SAR）推理策略，用于生成长序列。
AI.result: 该方法实现了视觉上引人注目且无缝衔接的一次性视频效果，同时保持了计算效率。
AI.conclusion: DreaMontage框架能够将零散的视觉素材转化为生动、连贯的一次性电影体验，实现了视觉上引人注目且无缝衔接的一次性视频效果，同时保持了计算效率。
AI.translation: “一次性”技术代表了电影制作中独特而精湛的美学。然而，其实际实现常常受到高昂成本和复杂现实约束的阻碍。尽管新兴的视频生成模型提供了虚拟替代方案，但现有方法通常依赖于简单的片段拼接，这往往无法保持视觉平滑性和时间连贯性。在本文中，我们介绍了DreaMontage，一个专为任意帧引导生成设计的综合框架，能够从用户提供的多样化输入合成无缝、富有表现力且长期的单次视频。为了实现这一目标，我们通过三个主要维度解决了这一挑战。（i）我们将一个轻量级的中间条件机制集成到DiT架构中。通过采用有效利用基础训练数据的自适应调优策略，我们解锁了强大的任意帧控制能力。（ii）为了增强视觉保真度和电影表现力，我们策划了一个高质量的数据集并实施了一个视觉表达SFT阶段。在解决主体运动合理性和过渡平滑性等关键问题时，我们应用了一个定制的DPO方案，这显著提高了生成内容的成功率和可用性。（iii）为了便于生成长序列，我们设计了一种内存高效的分段自回归（SAR）推理策略。广泛的实验表明，我们的方法在保持计算效率的同时，实现了视觉上引人注目且无缝衔接的一次性效果，使用户能够将零散的视觉素材转化为生动、连贯的一次性电影体验。
AI.summary: DreaMontage是一个新颖的视频生成框架，它通过一种任意帧引导的一次性方法，能够生成流畅、富有表现力且长期的视频。该框架通过集成轻量级中间条件机制、视觉表达微调以及分段自回归推理策略，解决了现有视频生成模型在保持视觉和时间连贯性方面的不足，并最终实现了高效且高质量的视频生成。
AI.keywords: 一次性视频生成, 任意帧引导, DreaMontage, 视觉连贯性, 时间连贯性
AI.comments: 该研究在一次性视频生成领域取得了显著进展，通过引入DreaMontage框架，有效解决了现有技术在视觉连贯性和时间一致性方面的痛点。其创新的多维度方法，包括轻量级中间条件机制、视觉表达SFT和定制DPO方案，以及分段自回归推理策略，共同提升了生成视频的质量和效率。然而，对于该框架在处理极端复杂场景或需要高度特定风格的视频生成任务上的表现，以及其对计算资源的需求，还需要进一步的评估。

title: ReaSeq: Unleashing World Knowledge via Reasoning for Sequential Modeling
summary:
Industrial recommender systems face two fundamental limitations under the log-driven paradigm: (1) knowledge poverty in ID-based item representations that causes brittle interest modeling under data sparsity, and (2) systemic blindness to beyond-log user interests that constrains model performance within platform boundaries. These limitations stem from an over-reliance on shallow interaction statistics and close-looped feedback while neglecting the rich world knowledge about product semantics and cross-domain behavioral patterns that Large Language Models have learned from vast corpora.
  To address these challenges, we introduce ReaSeq, a reasoning-enhanced framework that leverages world knowledge in Large Language Models to address both limitations through explicit and implicit reasoning. Specifically, ReaSeq employs explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning via multi-agent collaboration to distill structured product knowledge into semantically enriched item representations, and latent reasoning via Diffusion Large Language Models to infer plausible beyond-log behaviors. Deployed on Taobao's ranking system serving hundreds of millions of users, ReaSeq achieves substantial gains: >6.0% in IPV and CTR, >2.9% in Orders, and >2.5% in GMV, validating the effectiveness of world-knowledge-enhanced reasoning over purely log-driven approaches.

AI.title_translation: ReaSeq：通过推理释放世界知识以进行序列建模
AI.tldr: ReaSeq是一个利用大型语言模型的“世界知识”来改进推荐系统的框架，通过“链式思考”推理来丰富物品表示，并通过“潜在推理”来推断用户在日志之外的行为，在实际应用中显著提高了各项指标。
AI.motivation: 日志驱动的推荐系统存在两个主要局限性：基于ID的物品表示知识贫乏，导致数据稀疏时兴趣建模脆弱；以及对日志之外的用户兴趣的系统性视而不见，限制了模型性能。这些问题源于过度依赖浅层交互统计和封闭反馈循环，而忽略了大型语言模型从海量语料库中学到的关于产品语义和跨领域行为模式的丰富世界知识。
AI.method: ReaSeq框架通过显式和隐式推理利用大型语言模型的世界知识。具体来说，它采用多智能体协作的显式链式思考推理来提取结构化产品知识，生成语义丰富的物品表示；并利用扩散大型语言模型的潜在推理来推断潜在的、超出日志范围的用户行为。
AI.result: ReaSeq在淘宝的排序系统中得到部署，服务于数亿用户，并在IPV和CTR方面实现了超过6.0%的提升，订单数提升超过2.9%，GMV提升超过2.5%。
AI.conclusion: ReaSeq通过利用世界知识增强的推理，证明了其在推荐系统中的有效性，优于纯粹的日志驱动方法。
AI.translation: 工业推荐系统在日志驱动范式下面临两个根本性限制：(1) 基于ID的物品表示知识贫乏，在数据稀疏的情况下导致兴趣建模脆弱；(2) 对日志之外的用户兴趣的系统性视而不见，将模型性能限制在平台边界之内。这些限制源于对浅层交互统计和闭环反馈的过度依赖，而忽略了大型语言模型从海量语料库中学到的关于产品语义和跨域行为模式的丰富世界知识。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了ReaSeq，一个增强推理的框架，利用大型语言模型的世界知识来通过显式和隐式推理解决这两种限制。具体来说，ReaSeq通过多智能体协作的显式链式思考推理，将结构化产品知识提炼成语义丰富的物品表示；并通过扩散大型语言模型的潜在推理，推断出潜在的、超出日志范围的行为。ReaSeq在淘宝的排序系统中得到部署，服务于数亿用户，实现了显著的收益：IPV和CTR提高了6.0%以上，订单数提高了2.9%以上，GMV提高了2.5%以上，验证了世界知识增强推理相对于纯粹日志驱动方法的有效性。
AI.summary: ReaSeq是一个创新的推荐系统框架，它通过整合大型语言模型（LLM）的世界知识来解决传统日志驱动推荐系统的局限性。该框架利用链式思考（Chain-of-Thought）推理从LLM中提取产品知识，从而生成更丰富的物品表示，并结合扩散模型的潜在推理来捕捉用户在交互日志之外的潜在兴趣。在实际部署中，ReaSeq显著提升了关键业务指标，证明了其超越传统方法的优越性。
AI.keywords: 推荐系统,世界知识,大型语言模型,推理,序列建模
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将大型语言模型的世界知识和推理能力应用于推荐系统，解决了长期存在的知识贫乏和视野局限问题。通过显式和隐式推理相结合的方法，ReaSeq在实际应用中取得了显著的性能提升，为未来推荐系统的发展提供了新的方向。然而，模型的复杂性和对LLM的依赖性可能带来计算成本和可解释性方面的挑战。

title: AnyAD: Unified Any-Modality Anomaly Detection in Incomplete Multi-Sequence MRI
summary: Reliable anomaly detection in brain MRI remains challenging due to the scarcity of annotated abnormal cases and the frequent absence of key imaging modalities in real clinical workflows. Existing single-class or multi-class anomaly detection (AD) models typically rely on fixed modality configurations, require repetitive training, or fail to generalize to unseen modality combinations, limiting their clinical scalability. In this work, we present a unified Any-Modality AD framework that performs robust anomaly detection and localization under arbitrary MRI modality availability. The framework integrates a dual-pathway DINOv2 encoder with a feature distribution alignment mechanism that statistically aligns incomplete-modality features with full-modality representations, enabling stable inference even with severe modality dropout. To further enhance semantic consistency, we introduce an Intrinsic Normal Prototypes (INPs) extractor and an INP-guided decoder that reconstruct only normal anatomical patterns while naturally amplifying abnormal deviations. Through randomized modality masking and indirect feature completion during training, the model learns to adapt to all modality configurations without re-training. Extensive experiments on BraTS2018, MU-Glioma-Post, and Pretreat-MetsToBrain-Masks demonstrate that our approach consistently surpasses state-of-the-art industrial and medical AD baselines across 7 modality combinations, achieving superior generalization. This study establishes a scalable paradigm for multimodal medical AD under real-world, imperfect modality conditions. Our source code is available at https://github.com/wuchangw/AnyAD.

AI.title_translation: 任意模态：不完整多序列MRI中的统一任意模态异常检测
AI.tldr: AnyAD是一个创新的、无需重新训练的通用框架，用于处理缺失MRI模态的异常检测，通过特征对齐和正常原型重建实现稳定和优越的性能。
AI.motivation: 临床工作流程中存在关键成像模态的缺失，且现有单类或多类异常检测模型依赖于固定的模态配置，需要重复训练，或无法泛化到未见过的模态组合，限制了临床可扩展性。
AI.method: AnyAD框架集成了双通路DINOv2编码器和一个特征分布对齐机制，用于在统计上将不完整模态特征与完整模态表示对齐。此外，引入了内在正常原型（INP）提取器和INP引导的解码器，用于仅重建正常解剖模式。训练时采用随机模态掩码和间接特征补全。
AI.result: 在BraTS2018、MU-Glioma-Post和Pretreat-MetsToBrain-Masks上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在7种模态组合中持续超越最先进的工业和医学异常检测基线，实现了卓越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了一种在真实世界、不完整模态条件下进行多模态医学异常检测的可扩展范式。
AI.translation: 在脑部MRI中进行可靠的异常检测仍然具有挑战性，因为注释的异常病例稀缺，并且在实际临床工作流程中关键成像模态经常缺失。现有的单类或多类异常检测（AD）模型通常依赖于固定的模态配置，需要重复训练，或无法泛化到未见的模态组合，限制了其临床可扩展性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个统一的任意模态AD框架，它可以在任意MRI模态可用性下执行鲁棒的异常检测和定位。该框架集成了双通路DINOv2编码器和一个特征分布对齐机制，该机制在统计上将不完整模态特征与完整模态表示对齐，即使在严重的模态丢失情况下也能实现稳定的推理。为了进一步增强语义一致性，我们引入了一个内在正常原型（INP）提取器和一个INP引导的解码器，该解码器仅重建正常解剖模式，同时自然地放大异常偏差。通过训练期间的随机模态掩码和间接特征补全，模型学会适应所有模态配置而无需重新训练。在BraTS2018、MU-Glioma-Post和Pretreat-MetsToBrain-Masks上的广泛实验证明，我们的方法在7种模态组合中持续超越最先进的工业和医学AD基线，实现了卓越的泛化能力。本研究建立了一种在真实世界、不完整模态条件下进行多模态医学AD的可扩展范式。我们的源代码可在https://github.com/wuchangw/AnyAD获取。
AI.summary: AnyAD是一个统一的任意模态异常检测框架，旨在解决MRI数据中模态缺失和标注稀疏的问题。它通过整合DINOv2编码器和特征分布对齐机制，使模型能够在任意模态可用性下进行鲁棒的异常检测和定位。通过内在正常原型引导的重建，模型能自然地放大异常偏差，并通过训练时的模态掩码学习适应所有模态配置，无需重新训练，从而在真实世界的不完整模态条件下展示出优越的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 任意模态异常检测, MRI, 模态缺失, DINOv2, 特征对齐
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的框架（AnyAD），能够处理任意模态组合下的MRI异常检测，解决了现有方法对固定模态依赖的局限性。其重要性在于提高了模型在真实临床工作流程中的可扩展性和鲁棒性。局限性可能在于其对DINOv2编码器的依赖以及对“完整模态表示”的统计对齐策略的有效性在极端缺失情况下的表现。

title: ACD: Direct Conditional Control for Video Diffusion Models via Attention Supervision
summary: Controllability is a fundamental requirement in video synthesis, where accurate alignment with conditioning signals is essential. Existing classifier-free guidance methods typically achieve conditioning indirectly by modeling the joint distribution of data and conditions, which often results in limited controllability over the specified conditions. Classifier-based guidance enforces conditions through an external classifier, but the model may exploit this mechanism to raise the classifier score without genuinely satisfying the intended condition, resulting in adversarial artifacts and limited effective controllability. In this paper, we propose Attention-Conditional Diffusion (ACD), a novel framework for direct conditional control in video diffusion models via attention supervision. By aligning the model's attention maps with external control signals, ACD achieves better controllability. To support this, we introduce a sparse 3D-aware object layout as an efficient conditioning signal, along with a dedicated Layout ControlNet and an automated annotation pipeline for scalable layout integration. Extensive experiments on benchmark video generation datasets demonstrate that ACD delivers superior alignment with conditioning inputs while preserving temporal coherence and visual fidelity, establishing an effective paradigm for conditional video synthesis.

AI.title_translation: ACD：通过注意力监督实现视频扩散模型的直接条件控制
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为ACD的新框架，通过对视频扩散模型中的注意力图进行监督，实现了对视频生成过程的直接条件控制，从而提高了条件对齐能力，并引入了稀疏3D感知对象布局作为一种高效的条件信号。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成方法在条件控制方面存在局限性，例如分类器自由引导法控制能力有限，而基于分类器的引导法则可能导致对抗性伪影。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ACD（Attention-Conditional Diffusion）的新框架，通过对视频扩散模型中的注意力图与外部控制信号进行对齐来实现直接条件控制。此外，研究引入了稀疏3D感知对象布局作为一种高效的条件信号，并开发了专门的Layout ControlNet和自动标注流程。
AI.result: ACD框架在视频生成任务中，能够更好地与条件输入对齐，同时保持了时间连贯性和视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: ACD框架为条件视频合成提供了一个有效的范例，通过注意力监督实现了对视频扩散模型的直接条件控制，显著提高了条件对齐能力。
AI.translation: 可控性是视频合成中的基本要求，其中与条件信号的精确对齐至关重要。现有的无分类器引导方法通常通过对数据和条件的联合分布进行建模来实现间接的条件控制，这往往导致对指定条件的控制能力有限。基于分类器的引导通过外部分类器来强制执行条件，但模型可能会利用这种机制来提高分类器分数，而无需真正满足预期的条件，从而导致对抗性伪影和有限的有效可控性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的框架——注意力条件扩散（ACD），通过注意力监督实现视频扩散模型的直接条件控制。通过将模型的注意力图与外部控制信号进行对齐，ACD实现了更好的可控性。为了支持这一点，我们引入了稀疏的3D感知对象布局作为一种高效的条件信号，以及一个专用的Layout ControlNet和自动标注流程，以实现可扩展的布局集成。在基准视频生成数据集上的广泛实验表明，ACD在与条件输入对齐方面表现优越，同时保持了时间连贯性和视觉保真度，为条件视频合成建立了一个有效的范例。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为ACD（Attention-Conditional Diffusion）的新框架，旨在解决视频扩散模型中条件控制能力有限的问题。ACD通过对齐模型的注意力图与外部控制信号，实现了对视频生成过程的直接、更强的条件控制。研究还引入了稀疏3D感知对象布局作为一种高效的条件信号，并开发了相应的控制网络和标注流程。实验结果表明，ACD在提高条件对齐能力的同时，能够保持视频的时间连贯性和视觉质量。
AI.keywords: 视频扩散模型, 注意力监督, 条件控制, 对象布局, 视频合成
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的注意力监督方法来增强视频扩散模型的条件控制能力，这在视频合成领域具有重要的应用前景。引入稀疏3D感知对象布局作为条件信号是一个亮点，解决了现有方法在条件表示和集成方面的不足。然而，该方法在计算成本和对不同类型条件信号的泛化能力方面可能存在局限性。

title: GriDiT: Factorized Grid-Based Diffusion for Efficient Long Image Sequence Generation
summary: Modern deep learning methods typically treat image sequences as large tensors of sequentially stacked frames. However, is this straightforward representation ideal given the current state-of-the-art (SoTA)? In this work, we address this question in the context of generative models and aim to devise a more effective way of modeling image sequence data. Observing the inefficiencies and bottlenecks of current SoTA image sequence generation methods, we showcase that rather than working with large tensors, we can improve the generation process by factorizing it into first generating the coarse sequence at low resolution and then refining the individual frames at high resolution. We train a generative model solely on grid images comprising subsampled frames. Yet, we learn to generate image sequences, using the strong self-attention mechanism of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to capture correlations between frames. In effect, our formulation extends a 2D image generator to operate as a low-resolution 3D image-sequence generator without introducing any architectural modifications. Subsequently, we super-resolve each frame individually to add the sequence-independent high-resolution details. This approach offers several advantages and can overcome key limitations of the SoTA in this domain. Compared to existing image sequence generation models, our method achieves superior synthesis quality and improved coherence across sequences. It also delivers high-fidelity generation of arbitrary-length sequences and increased efficiency in inference time and training data usage. Furthermore, our straightforward formulation enables our method to generalize effectively across diverse data domains, which typically require additional priors and supervision to model in a generative context. Our method consistently outperforms SoTA in quality and inference speed (at least twice-as-fast) across datasets.

AI.title_translation: 因子化基于网格的扩散用于高效长图像序列生成
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为GriDiT的新方法，通过将长图像序列生成分解为两个阶段：首先生成低分辨率的粗糙序列，然后单独提高每个帧的分辨率，从而提高了效率和生成质量。
AI.motivation: 当前深度学习方法将图像序列视为大型张量，但这并非理想的表示方式，并且存在效率低下和瓶颈问题。本研究旨在提出一种更有效的图像序列建模方法。
AI.method: 该方法将图像序列生成分解为两个阶段：1. 生成低分辨率的粗糙序列，利用扩散Transformer（DiT）的自注意力机制捕捉帧间相关性，将2D图像生成器扩展为低分辨率3D图像序列生成器。2. 单独对每个帧进行超分辨率处理，添加序列无关的高分辨率细节。
AI.result: 与现有模型相比，该方法在合成质量和序列连贯性方面表现更优，能够生成任意长度的高保真序列，并提高了推理速度（至少快一倍）和训练数据使用效率。
AI.conclusion: GriDiT通过将图像序列生成分解为粗糙序列生成和帧单独超分辨率两个阶段，克服了现有方法的局限性，实现了更高的生成质量、连贯性、效率和泛化能力。
AI.translation: 现代深度学习方法通常将图像序列视为堆叠的帧的大型张量。然而，鉴于当前最先进（SoTA）的技术水平，这种直接的表示是理想的吗？在本工作中，我们在生成模型的背景下解决了这个问题，并旨在提出一种更有效的对图像序列数据进行建模的方法。观察到当前最先进的图像序列生成方法存在效率低下和瓶颈，我们展示了，与其处理大型张量，不如通过将其分解为首先生成低分辨率的粗糙序列，然后单独精炼各个帧，来改进生成过程。我们仅在包含子采样帧的网格图像上训练生成模型。然而，我们利用扩散Transformer（DiT）的强大自注意力机制来捕捉帧间的相关性，从而学会生成图像序列。实际上，我们的方法将一个2D图像生成器扩展为低分辨率的3D图像序列生成器，而无需进行任何架构修改。随后，我们单独对每个帧进行超分辨率处理，以添加序列无关的高分辨率细节。这种方法具有几个优点，并且可以克服该领域当前最先进技术的关键局限性。与现有的图像序列生成模型相比，我们的方法在合成质量和序列连贯性方面均优于现有模型。它还能实现任意长度序列的高保真生成，并提高推理时间和训练数据使用效率。此外，我们直接的公式使我们的方法能够有效地推广到不同的数据域，而这些数据域通常需要额外的先验和监督才能在生成环境中进行建模。我们的方法在质量和推理速度（至少快一倍）方面持续优于跨数据集的最先进技术。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为GriDiT（因子化基于网格的扩散）的新方法，用于高效生成长图像序列。与传统的将图像序列视为单一大型张量的方法不同，GriDiT将生成过程分解为两个阶段：首先，在低分辨率下生成序列的粗糙结构；然后，对每个帧进行单独的高分辨率细节增强。该方法利用扩散Transformer（DiT）的自注意力机制来捕捉帧间依赖性，并将2D图像生成器扩展为3D序列生成器，而无需修改其架构。实验结果表明，GriDiT在合成质量、序列连贯性、生成长度灵活性、推理速度和数据效率方面均优于现有最先进方法，并具有良好的跨领域泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 图像序列生成, 扩散模型, 因子化生成, 扩散Transformer, 超分辨率
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的多阶段方法来解决长图像序列生成中的效率和质量问题。通过将生成过程分解为粗糙序列生成和逐帧超分辨率，GriDiT有效地利用了DiT的强大能力，并在不增加复杂性的情况下实现了显著的性能提升。其在速度和质量上的优势，以及良好的泛化能力，使其成为该领域一个有前景的方向。然而，对于不同类型序列数据的泛化能力和对计算资源的具体需求仍需进一步探讨。

title: SMART SLM: Structured Memory and Reasoning Transformer, A Small Language Model for Accurate Document Assistance
summary: The user of Engineering Manuals (EM) finds it difficult to read EM s because they are long, have a dense format which includes written documents, step by step procedures, and standard parameter lists for engineering equipment. Off the shelf transformers, especially compact ones, treat this material as a flat stream of tokens. This approach leads to confident but incorrect numeric answers and forces the models to memorize separate facts inefficiently. SMART (Structured Memory and Reasoning Transformer) offers a different and practical solution to the above problem. SMART structures its processing by using a hierarchical approach, and is based upon three main job categories (1) A syntax-aware Fact Extractor (Grammarian) Tree LSTM which extracts facts as subject relation object relations from EM sentences (2) A compact indexed memory MANN (Memory Augmented Neural Network) that indexes these Rational Subject Relation Objects as 384 dimensional vectors that are associated with the source of the information, and (3) A 6 layer Transformer that learns to fuse the previously retrieved facts into its generated response. The entire SMART model utilizes 45.51M parameters, which is 64% less than GPT-2 (124M) and 69% less than BERT (133M), and it achieves a 21.3% higher accuracy than GPT-2, indicating that SMART fits the data better with the least amount of processing requirements. SMART employs dual modes of inference an indexed fast path for known documents (sub-second answer times) and an indexed dynamic path assisted by RAGs for new uploads (FAISS Top 20 results with memory severed at 64 slots). In real world deployment, this framework leads to more well supported results with reduced hallucinations than comparable small transformer models.

title: Surgical Scene Segmentation using a Spike-Driven Video Transformer with Real-Time Potential
summary: Modern surgical systems increasingly rely on intelligent scene understanding to provide timely situational awareness for enhanced intra-operative safety. Within this pipeline, surgical scene segmentation plays a central role in accurately perceiving operative events. Although recent deep learning models, particularly large-scale foundation models, achieve remarkable segmentation accuracy, their substantial computational demands and power consumption hinder real-time deployment in resource-constrained surgical environments. To address this limitation, we explore the emerging SNN as a promising paradigm for highly efficient surgical intelligence. However, their performance is still constrained by the scarcity of labeled surgical data and the inherently sparse nature of surgical video representations. To this end, we propose \textit{SpikeSurgSeg}, the first spike-driven video Transformer framework tailored for surgical scene segmentation with real-time potential on non-GPU platforms. To address the limited availability of surgical annotations, we introduce a surgical-scene masked autoencoding pretraining strategy for SNNs that enables robust spatiotemporal representation learning via layer-wise tube masking. Building on this pretrained backbone, we further adopt a lightweight spike-driven segmentation head that produces temporally consistent predictions while preserving the low-latency characteristics of SNNs. Extensive experiments on EndoVis18 and our in-house SurgBleed dataset demonstrate that SpikeSurgSeg achieves mIoU comparable to SOTA ANN-based models while reducing inference latency by at least $8\times$. Notably, it delivers over $20\times$ acceleration relative to most foundation-model baselines, underscoring its potential for time-critical surgical scene segmentation.

AI.title_translation: 基于脉冲驱动视频变换器的外科场景分割及其实时潜力
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SpikeSurgSeg的脉冲驱动视频变换器框架，用于外科场景分割，旨在实现低延迟和高效率，并在实验中取得了与先进模型相当的准确率，同时显著降低了推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的外科场景分割模型计算需求大、功耗高，难以在资源受限的手术环境中实时部署。需要一种高效的外科智能解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SpikeSurgSeg框架，该框架是第一个针对外科场景分割的脉冲驱动视频变换器。结合了用于SNN的掩码自动编码预训练策略（通过层级管状掩码实现时空表示学习）和一个轻量级的脉冲驱动分割头（用于生成时间一致的预测）。
AI.result: SpikeSurgSeg在EndoVis18和SurgBleed数据集上实现了与SOTA ANN模型相当的mIoU，同时推理延迟降低了至少8倍，相对于大多数基础模型基线加速超过20倍。
AI.conclusion: SpikeSurgSeg框架在实现高效率的同时，在外科场景分割任务上取得了具有竞争力的性能，证明了其在时间关键型应用中的潜力，特别是在非GPU平台上实现实时部署。
AI.translation: 现代外科手术系统越来越依赖智能场景理解，以提供及时的态势感知，从而增强术中安全性。在此流程中，外科场景分割在准确感知手术事件方面起着核心作用。尽管最近的深度学习模型，特别是大规模基础模型，取得了卓越的分割精度，但其巨大的计算需求和功耗阻碍了在资源受限的手术环境中进行实时部署。为了解决这一限制，我们探索了新兴的SNN作为一种高效率的外科智能的有望范式。然而，它们的性能仍然受到标记外科数据稀缺以及手术视频表示固有稀疏性的限制。为此，我们提出了	extit{SpikeSurgSeg}，这是第一个专门为外科场景分割设计的脉冲驱动视频变换器框架，具有在非GPU平台上实时运行的潜力。为了解决手术标注可用性有限的问题，我们引入了一种用于SNN的外科场景掩码自动编码预训练策略，该策略通过层级管状掩码实现强大的时空表示学习。在此预训练骨干的基础上，我们进一步采用了一个轻量级的脉冲驱动分割头，该分割头可生成时间一致的预测，同时保留SNN的低延迟特性。在EndoVis18和我们内部的SurgBleed数据集上的广泛实验表明，SpikeSurgSeg实现了与SOTA ANN模型相当的mIoU，同时将推理延迟降低了至少8倍。值得注意的是，它相对于大多数基础模型基线提供了超过20倍的加速，凸显了其在时间关键型外科场景分割中的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了SpikeSurgSeg，一个创新的脉冲驱动视频变换器框架，用于解决外科场景分割的实时部署挑战。该框架通过采用SNN和一种新的掩码自动编码预训练策略，在保持高分割精度的同时，显著降低了计算成本和延迟，使其适合资源受限的手术环境。

title: Post-Processing Mask-Based Table Segmentation for Structural Coordinate Extraction
summary: Structured data extraction from tables plays a crucial role in document image analysis for scanned documents and digital archives. Although many methods have been proposed to detect table structures and extract cell contents, accurately identifying table segment boundaries (rows and columns) remains challenging, particularly in low-resolution or noisy images. In many real-world scenarios, table data are incomplete or degraded, limiting the adaptability of transformer-based methods to noisy inputs. Mask-based edge detection techniques have shown greater robustness under such conditions, as their sensitivity can be adjusted through threshold tuning; however, existing approaches typically apply masks directly to images, leading to noise sensitivity, resolution loss, or high computational cost. This paper proposes a novel multi-scale signal-processing method for detecting table edges from table masks. Row and column transitions are modeled as one-dimensional signals and processed using Gaussian convolution with progressively increasing variances, followed by statistical thresholding to suppress noise while preserving stable structural edges. Detected signal peaks are mapped back to image coordinates to obtain accurate segment boundaries. Experimental results show that applying the proposed approach to column edge detection improves Cell-Aware Segmentation Accuracy (CASA) a layout-aware metric evaluating both textual correctness and correct cell placement from 67% to 76% on the PubLayNet-1M benchmark when using TableNet with PyTesseract OCR. The method is robust to resolution variations through zero-padding and scaling strategies and produces optimized structured tabular outputs suitable for downstream analysis.

title: Model Merging via Multi-Teacher Knowledge Distillation
summary: Model merging has emerged as a lightweight alternative to joint multi-task learning (MTL), yet the generalization properties of merged models remain largely unexplored. Establishing such theoretical guarantees is non-trivial, as the merging process typically forbids access to the original training data and involves combining fine-tuned models trained on fundamentally heterogeneous data distributions. Without a principled understanding of these dynamics, current methods often rely on heuristics to approximate the optimal combination of parameters. This dependence is most critical in coefficient scaling, the weighting factors that modulate the magnitude of each fine-tuned model's contribution to the shared parameter. However, without a principled objective to guide their selection, these methods lead to brittle performance and are highly sensitive to scaling initialization. We address this gap by (i) establishing a novel flatness-aware PAC-Bayes generalization bound specifically for the model merging setting. This analysis introduces a "cross-task heterogeneity" term that formally captures the mismatch between diverse fine-tuned model priors and the target multi-task distributions. Guided by this theoretical insight, (ii) we frame model merging as multi-teacher knowledge distillation on scarce, unlabeled data. We formally demonstrate that minimizing the student-teacher Kullback-Leibler divergence directly tightens the upper bound on the merged model's excess risk. Guided by the flatness-aware bound derived, (iii) we operationalize this objective via SAMerging, a method that employs Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to find flat minima. Empirically, SAMerging establishes a new state of the art across vision and NLP benchmarks, achieving remarkable performance. The code is available at https://github.com/arshandalili/SAMerging.

title: Quadrupped-Legged Robot Movement Plan Generation using Large Language Model
authors: Vincentius Gusti Putu A. B. M.
summary: Traditional control interfaces for quadruped robots often impose a high barrier to entry, requiring specialized technical knowledge for effective operation. To address this, this paper presents a novel control framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) to enable intuitive, natural language-based navigation. We propose a distributed architecture where high-level instruction processing is offloaded to an external server to overcome the onboard computational constraints of the DeepRobotics Jueying Lite 3 platform. The system grounds LLM-generated plans into executable ROS navigation commands using real-time sensor fusion (LiDAR, IMU, and Odometry). Experimental validation was conducted in a structured indoor environment across four distinct scenarios, ranging from single-room tasks to complex cross-zone navigation. The results demonstrate the system's robustness, achieving an aggregate success rate of over 90\% across all scenarios, validating the feasibility of offloaded LLM-based planning for autonomous quadruped deployment in real-world settings.

title: Enhancing Grid Resilience for Giga-Watt Scale Data Centers Using High Voltage Circuit Breaker Operated Braking Resistors
comments: Provincially accepted for publication in 2025 IEEE International Conference on Energy Technologies for Future Grids (ETFG) conference proceedings
summary: As hyperscale and co-located data centers scale, the electric grid sees an increase in large, voltage-sensitive IT loads with these data center plant size ranging between 500 MW to 2 GW. A sudden loss of these loads as they switch to onsite UPS during grid voltage excursion events causes a grid frequency rise from generation and load imbalance, and a voltage rise because less power is flowing through the network. This paper proposes and theoretically demonstrates the use of high voltage circuit breaker operated braking resistors at data center transmission substations as an effective strategy in enhancing grid resilience under such large load loss scenarios. We developed a test bed to illustrate the dynamic behavior of the system with resistive braking on a gigawatt scale data center load cluster connected to a 345 kV network. The braking resistor(s), which in the case of inverter rich system comes in a multi-stage configuration, are connected or disconnected via high-speed circuit breaker(s). Results show that insertion for 0.25 to 0.85 seconds sufficiently reduce rate of change of frequency and provides time for primary governor response and capacitor switching to restore steady state. Sensitivity across different synchronous machines and inverter-based resource mix are tested and confirms robustness. We conclude circuit breaker controlled resistive braking is a practical means to enhance Bulk Electric System (BES) resilience for gigawatt scale data centers. The approach integrates with protection, needs no generator changes, and can be scaled with cluster size or growth of the data center facility load.

title: A mixed finite element method for the stochastic Boussinesq equations with multiplicative noise
summary: This work investigates a fully discrete mixed finite element method for the stochastic Boussinesq system driven by multiplicative noise. The spatial discretization is performed using a standard mixed finite element method, while the temporal discretization is based on a semi-implicit Euler-Maruyama scheme. By combining a localization technique with high-moment stability estimates, we establish error bounds for the velocity, pressure, and temperature approximations. As a direct consequence, we prove convergence in probability for the fully discrete method in both $L^2$ and $H^1$-type norms. Several numerical experiments are presented to validate the theoretical error estimates and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

title: Transcriptome-Conditioned Personalized De Novo Drug Generation for AML Using Metaheuristic Assembly and Target-Driven Filtering
summary: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) remains a clinical challenge due to its extreme molecular heterogeneity and high relapse rates. While precision medicine has introduced mutation-specific therapies, many patients still lack effective, personalized options. This paper presents a novel, end-to-end computational framework that bridges the gap between patient-specific transcriptomics and de novo drug discovery. By analyzing bulk RNA sequencing data from the TCGA-LAML cohort, the study utilized Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) to prioritize 20 high-value biomarkers, including metabolic transporters like HK3 and immune-modulatory receptors such as SIGLEC9. The physical structures of these targets were modeled using AlphaFold3, and druggable hotspots were quantitatively mapped via the DOGSiteScorer engine. Then developed a novel, reaction-first evolutionary metaheuristic algorithm as well as multi-objective optimization programming that assembles novel ligands from fragment libraries, guided by spatial alignment to these identified hotspots. The generative model produced structurally unique chemical entities with a strong bias toward drug-like space, as evidenced by QED scores peaking between 0.5 and 0.7. Validation through ADMET profiling and SwissDock molecular docking identified high-confidence candidates, such as Ligand L1, which achieved a binding free energy of -6.571 kcal/mol against the A08A96 biomarker. These results demonstrate that integrating systems biology with metaheuristic molecular assembly can produce pharmacologically viable, patient tailored leads, offering a scalable blueprint for precision oncology in AML and beyond

title: AndroidLens: Long-latency Evaluation with Nested Sub-targets for Android GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents can substantially improve productivity by automating frequently executed long-latency tasks on mobile devices. However, existing evaluation benchmarks are still constrained to limited applications, simple tasks, and coarse-grained metrics. To address this, we introduce AndroidLens, a challenging evaluation framework for mobile GUI agents, comprising 571 long-latency tasks in both Chinese and English environments, each requiring an average of more than 26 steps to complete. The framework features: (1) tasks derived from real-world user scenarios across 38 domains, covering complex types such as multi-constraint, multi-goal, and domain-specific tasks; (2) static evaluation that preserves real-world anomalies and allows multiple valid paths to reduce bias; and (3) dynamic evaluation that employs a milestone-based scheme for fine-grained progress measurement via Average Task Progress (ATP). Our evaluation indicates that even the best models reach only a 12.7% task success rate and 50.47% ATP. We also underscore key challenges in real-world environments, including environmental anomalies, adaptive exploration, and long-term memory retention.

title: FORCE-$α$ Numerical Fluxes within the Arbitrary High Order Semidiscrete WENO-DeC Framework: A Competitive Alternative to Upwind Fluxes
summary:
This work systematically investigates the performance of FORCE--$α$ numerical fluxes within an arbitrary high order semidiscrete finite volume (FV) framework for hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs). Such numerical fluxes have been recently introduced by Toro, Saggiorato, Tokareva, and Hidalgo (Journal of Computational Physics, 416, 2020), and constitute a family of centred fluxes obtained from a suitable modification of First--Order Centred (FORCE) numerical fluxes. In contrast with upwind fluxes, such as Rusanov, Harten--Lax--van Leer (HLL) or the exact Riemann solver (RS) numerical flux, centred ones do not consider in any way the structure of the Riemann problem at cell interfaces. Adopting centred numerical fluxes leads to a high level of flexibility of the resulting numerical schemes, for example in the context of complicated hyperbolic systems, for which RSs may be impossible to construct or computationally expensive.
  The baseline framework adopted in this investigation is a FV semidiscrete approach with Weighted Essentially Non--Oscillatory (WENO) spatial reconstruction and Deferred Correction (DeC) time discretization, and results are reported up to order 7. Previous investigations involving the same framework have established that increasing the order of accuracy tends to decrease the differences in the results obtained through different numerical fluxes. The goal of this paper is to show that the employment of FORCE--$α$ numerical fluxes within such a framework is a competitive alternative to the adoption of more classical upwind fluxes. The hyperbolic system considered for this investigation is the ideal Euler equations in one and two space dimensions.

title: A Plan Reuse Mechanism for LLM-Driven Agent
comments: This paper is an English version of A Plan Reuse Mechanism for LLM-Driven Agent published in 2024 in the Journal of Computer Research and Development
summary: Integrating large language models (LLMs) into personal assistants, like Xiao Ai and Blue Heart V, effectively enhances their ability to interact with humans, solve complex tasks, and manage IoT devices. Such assistants are also termed LLM-driven agents. Upon receiving user requests, the LLM-driven agent generates plans using an LLM, executes these plans through various tools, and then returns the response to the user. During this process, the latency for generating a plan with an LLM can reach tens of seconds, significantly degrading user experience. Real-world dataset analysis shows that about 30% of the requests received by LLM-driven agents are identical or similar, which allows the reuse of previously generated plans to reduce latency. However, it is difficult to accurately define the similarity between the request texts received by the LLM-driven agent through directly evaluating the original request texts. Moreover, the diverse expressions of natural language and the unstructured format of plan texts make implementing plan reuse challenging. To address these issues, we present and implement a plan reuse mechanism for LLM-driven agents called AgentReuse. AgentReuse leverages the similarities and differences among requests' semantics and uses intent classification to evaluate the similarities between requests and enable the reuse of plans. Experimental results based on a real-world dataset demonstrate that AgentReuse achieves a 93% effective plan reuse rate, an F1 score of 0.9718, and an accuracy of 0.9459 in evaluating request similarities, reducing latency by 93.12% compared with baselines without using the reuse mechanism.

title: Learning to Solve PDEs on Neural Shape Representations
summary: Solving partial differential equations (PDEs) on shapes underpins many shape analysis and engineering tasks; yet, prevailing PDE solvers operate on polygonal/triangle meshes while modern 3D assets increasingly live as neural representations. This mismatch leaves no suitable method to solve surface PDEs directly within the neural domain, forcing explicit mesh extraction or per-instance residual training, preventing end-to-end workflows. We present a novel, mesh-free formulation that learns a local update operator conditioned on neural (local) shape attributes, enabling surface PDEs to be solved directly where the (neural) data lives. The operator integrates naturally with prevalent neural surface representations, is trained once on a single representative shape, and generalizes across shape and topology variations, enabling accurate, fast inference without explicit meshing or per-instance optimization while preserving differentiability. Across analytic benchmarks (heat equation and Poisson solve on sphere) and real neural assets across different representations, our method slightly outperforms CPM while remaining reasonably close to FEM, and, to our knowledge, delivers the first end-to-end pipeline that solves surface PDEs on both neural and classical surface representations. Code will be released on acceptance.

title: A Lyapunov-Based Small-Gain Theorem for Fixed-Time ISS: Theory, Optimization, and Games
summary: We develop a Lyapunov-based small-gain theorem for establishing fixed-time input-to-state stability (FxT-ISS) guarantees in interconnected nonlinear dynamical systems. The proposed framework considers interconnections in which each subsystem admits a FxT-ISS Lyapunov function, providing robustness with respect to external inputs. We show that, under an appropriate nonlinear small-gain condition, the overall interconnected system inherits the FxT-ISS property. In this sense, the proposed result complements existing Lyapunov-based smallgain theorems for asymptotic and finite-time stability, and enables a systematic analysis of interconnection structures exhibiting fixed-time stability. To illustrate the applicability of the theory, we study feedback-based optimization problems with time-varying cost functions, and Nash-equilibrium seeking for noncooperative games with nonlinear dynamical plants in the loop. For both problems, we present a class of non-smooth gradient or pseudogradient-based controllers that achieve fixed-time convergence without requiring time-scale separation and using real-time feedback. Numerical examples are provided to validate the theoretical findings.

title: Does the Data Processing Inequality Reflect Practice? On the Utility of Low-Level Tasks
summary: The data processing inequality is an information-theoretic principle stating that the information content of a signal cannot be increased by processing the observations. In particular, it suggests that there is no benefit in enhancing the signal or encoding it before addressing a classification problem. This assertion can be proven to be true for the case of the optimal Bayes classifier. However, in practice, it is common to perform "low-level" tasks before "high-level" downstream tasks despite the overwhelming capabilities of modern deep neural networks. In this paper, we aim to understand when and why low-level processing can be beneficial for classification. We present a comprehensive theoretical study of a binary classification setup, where we consider a classifier that is tightly connected to the optimal Bayes classifier and converges to it as the number of training samples increases. We prove that for any finite number of training samples, there exists a pre-classification processing that improves the classification accuracy. We also explore the effect of class separation, training set size, and class balance on the relative gain from this procedure. We support our theory with an empirical investigation of the theoretical setup. Finally, we conduct an empirical study where we investigate the effect of denoising and encoding on the performance of practical deep classifiers on benchmark datasets. Specifically, we vary the size and class distribution of the training set, and the noise level, and demonstrate trends that are consistent with our theoretical results.

title: Variationally correct operator learning: Reduced basis neural operator with a posteriori error estimation
summary: Minimizing PDE-residual losses is a common strategy to promote physical consistency in neural operators. However, standard formulations often lack variational correctness, meaning that small residuals do not guarantee small solution errors due to the use of non-compliant norms or ad hoc penalty terms for boundary conditions. This work develops a variationally correct operator learning framework by constructing first-order system least-squares (FOSLS) objectives whose values are provably equivalent to the solution error in PDE-induced norms. We demonstrate this framework on stationary diffusion and linear elasticity, incorporating mixed Dirichlet-Neumann boundary conditions via variational lifts to preserve norm equivalence without inconsistent penalties. To ensure the function space conformity required by the FOSLS loss, we propose a Reduced Basis Neural Operator (RBNO). The RBNO predicts coefficients for a pre-computed, conforming reduced basis, thereby ensuring variational stability by design while enabling efficient training. We provide a rigorous convergence analysis that bounds the total error by the sum of finite element discretization bias, reduced basis truncation error, neural network approximation error, and statistical estimation errors arising from finite sampling and optimization. Numerical benchmarks validate these theoretical bounds and demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves superior accuracy in PDE-compliant norms compared to standard baselines, while the residual loss serves as a reliable, computable a posteriori error estimator.
